section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single participant sample (N = 781 after excluding 82 ineligible participants), comprising 390 women and 391 men recruited from Selangor and the Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur in Malaysia. Participants were aged 18–63 years (M = 27.27, SD = 10.00) with self-reported BMI ranging 14.69–45.45 (M = 23.52, SD = 5.04); educational attainment included 52.6% undergraduate and 20.0% further degree (college-or-higher = 72.6%).
